source_specification.retained_source: original two-ramp source; independent form and lifted-phase errors bounded by 1e-10 with separate exact zero sums in each original C9
source_specification.nominal_initial_form: m*(j-4) in regions 0,1 and zero in region 2; m=(2046/9)*(355/113)**2
source_specification.nominal_initial_phase: zero at every node in the supplied common continuous lift
source_specification.state_order: x[0:27], theta[0:27]; nominal reference uses 13 reflected coordinates, actual uncertainty retains the complete mean-zero leaf
source_specification.support: three unit C9 cycles; oriented region contacts (0,1),(1,2),(2,0), offsets 0,1 with weight 1/2; weighted degree four; present from preparation
source_specification.clock: tau=(1023/1024)*t; u=gamma**2*(tau-400); gamma=1/(1023*pi); both rows transformed
source_specification.forcing: none; no Gamma source, state resets, support events or conductance evolution
source_specification.conserved_means: only global form and continuous-phase means after connected evolution starts
source_specification.source_cost: complete weighted initial storage, including contacts; no isolated recovered-source certificate
source_specification.release: source-inclusive phase ball and carried original form from tau=400; donor retention from tau=200 to release independently admitted

kernel_policy.metric: 2*I_13; exact reflection lift preserves the full Euclidean norm
kernel_policy.source_and_remainder: full-source phase radius plus complete-row defect; local Taylor remainder added at every endpoint

reserved_attempt_policy.step_retention: exclusive sequential JSON files for accepted steps and any failed attempt, written before the next step; final outcome retains exact byte receipts
reserved_attempt_policy.interruption: preserve exclusive attempt and every retained prefix file; no automatic resume or retry
reserved_attempt_policy.export_failure: preserve partial output and prefix; record export-error metadata when possible
reserved_attempt_policy.positive_outcome: whole-source donor retention and same-state receiver winding one, full target cell and full form-phase capture
reserved_attempt_policy.donor_loss_outcome: at least one donor has robust endpoint winding different from one; quantified for actual admitted source through the full tube
reserved_attempt_policy.unavailable_outcome: enclosure, uncertainty or horizon budget exhausted without the required certificate; not proof of nonformation
